title: Unindexed repository code search cannot adjudicate missing continuity identifiers

observed: The connected repository metadata reports is_code_search_indexed=false for MirrorCartographer/mirror-cartographer-ui.
Repository-scoped connector searches for the exact identifiers M-004, M-005, and M-006 each returned zero results.
The canonical continuity queue still classifies the provenance and immutable locations of M-004, M-005, and M-006 as unresolved.
inferred: Zero-result code searches cannot establish repository-wide absence while the repository is reported as not code-search indexed.
The three zero-result searches add no admissible negative evidence to the provenance-gap adjudication beyond documenting connector coverage limits.
proposed: Resolve M-004, M-005, and M-006 only through exhaustive authenticated Git object or tree traversal, retained refs enumeration, or immutable source objects located through an independently complete mechanism.
Record future search results with an explicit search_index_status and coverage_class before using them in continuity decisions.
superseded: Treating exact-identifier zero-result connector code searches as proof that the identifiers are absent from repository history.
unresolved: The complete branch, tree, and historical object inventory remains unenumerated.
The immutable provenance and locations of M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved.
The originating decision log, language lexicon, project document, or chat-history source assigning those identifiers remains unlocated.

contradiction_resolution.apparent_contradiction: Exact identifier searches return no matches while prior completion prose and the active queue refer to M-004, M-005, and M-006.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: Because repository code search is reported as unindexed, zero results are classified as coverage_unavailable rather than absence. Prior completion prose remains lead-only and the identifiers remain quarantined as unresolved.

provenance.locator: repository-scoped exact searches for M-004, M-005, and M-006

falsification_route: Produce a retained exhaustive Git refs, tree, and history traversal or immutable source object that either locates one of M-004, M-005, or M-006 or proves complete historical coverage without that identifier.
